rule: No automatic re-test waiver or blanket re-test order. Responsible engineers document impact and required regression before return to service; ranges identify records to REVIEW, not permission to execute them.

changes.change: Wheel/rail profile, diameter, gauge or worn limits
changes.impact_review: Recheck rolling radius/brake torque, adhesion/contact/turnouts, axle/bearings, swept/stair clearance, floor states, gearing and stopping.
Recheck wheel-load sharing/twist/roll, guide and brake-reaction compatibility, body bearing/frame loads, couplings/hoses and loaded boarding heights.

Reconcile service/spring curves, full32coach plus loco count/volumes, pressure/force timing, anti-compounding, heat, low-force reverse behavior, compressor/power and separation both portions. No prior hydraulic test equivalence.
Revise tolerance/thermal/wet/load-bypass stack, local receiving loads and exact proof/fatigue specimens; separately map accessible attachments.

changes.existing_records_to_review: E04 E10 E11 E12 J-T12 K-ST08 K-ST09 K-ST19
changes.impact_review: Reconcile installed continuous maps, intake/exhaust/heat, shaft/electrical power assignment and auxiliaries counted once; starting/fault/bond/neutral/reserve and brake/egress loss paths.

changes.change: Route, rail/joints, formation, stations or operating direction
changes.existing_records_to_review: E01 E07 E08 E09 E13 E14 J-T12 K-ST07 K-ST16
changes.impact_review: New survey/track geometry and wheel compatibility, curves/transitions/clearances/drainage, station loaded interface, rescue access, dispatch/occupancy and leading visibility; no automatic reversing/two-train clearance.

changes.change: Door, stair, guard, lift/ramp, accessible route or evacuation arrangement
changes.impact_review: Recheck actual occupied circulation, structural loads, floor/load states, hinge/stow/travel sweep, interlocks/manual recovery and emergency/maintenance procedures. Equipment qualification precedes participant exercises.

Quarantine affected revision; responsible engineer determines reanalysis and inspection/qualification/regression. Same nominal dimensions do not establish material/process equivalence. Restore actual controlled as-built and inspection records.
